patterns.problem: After owners report a new batch field done, the operator has to point out it is missing from the printed brew sheet, in four tasks, because the print template lists batch fields by hand.
patterns.fix: Render the printed brew sheet from the same field list as the batch screen, and add a test that every batch screen field appears on the print.

patterns.problem: Owners re-post their merge approval question after every rebase or trivial push, with no operator input in between, in four tasks.
patterns.fix: The owner instructions say a pending approval question stays open across routine rebases and small fixes, and is re-asked only when the change itself materially changes.

patterns.problem: The browser test test_fermentation_chart_renders times out waiting for the chart canvas on unrelated PRs and needs a CI recheck in five tasks.
patterns.fix: Fix test_fermentation_chart_renders in the project's browser tests to wait for the chart to report it has rendered instead of a fixed five-second timeout.

decoys.why: The refused merge approval was the operator holding till changes until Monday.
Two CI rechecks with different named causes (a registry outage and a full runner disk), unrelated to the chart test.
A single resume failure after a scheduled host restart, resumed by L3.
